diagnosis: The verify framework reports the FastAPI app is unreachable at http://localhost:8000/ after 60 seconds (fixAttempts=2). Static analysis shows all Python app code is clean: app/models.py has no inventory_code column, app/routes/stock.py and app/repositories/stock.py have no inventory_code references, and no syntax errors are visible. The migration 20260811000002 correctly drops inventory_code. The two Driver fix attempts were most likely triggered by client/tests/pages/SkuDetail.test.tsx T38 failing (the test's local StockDetailRow type still carries inventory_code and its T38 assertion expects the cell to contain row.inventory_code!, but the component now renders batch_number/serial_number — that test is separately flagged superseded in superseded-tests.json). One or both fix attempts introduced a change that now prevents uvicorn from binding on port 8000 within 60 seconds. Without uvicorn startup logs the exact error is not determinable from static analysis alone. Required human steps: (1) run the app manually with 'uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000' and capture the startup error; (2) revert any Driver changes that are not required by AC1-column-dropped (the only necessary changes are the 20260811000002 migration and removing inventory_code from app/models.py — both already present and correct); (3) kill any prior process holding port 8000; (4) if using Lakebase credentials, run 'databricks auth login' to refresh the token.
